items.uz: Tezkor javob choralari ko'rib chiqilishi kerak.
items.en: Rapid response measures need to be considered.

items.uz: Bu vaziyat barqaror boshqaruvni talab qiladi.
items.en: This situation requires stable management.

items.uz: Jamoa a'zolari orasida aniq vazifalar taqsimlandi.
items.en: Clear tasks were distributed among team members.

items.uz: Har bir qaror oqibatlarini hisobga olib qabul qilinishi kerak.
items.en: Every decision must be made taking its consequences into account.

items.uz: Bu inqiroz kompaniyaning moslashuvchanligini sinovdan o'tkazdi.
items.en: This crisis tested the company's adaptability.

items.uz: Ochiq muloqot ishonchni saqlab qoldi.
items.en: Open communication preserved trust.

items.uz: Bunday vaziyatlarda tajriba katta ahamiyat kasb etadi.
items.en: Experience takes on great importance in such situations.

items.uz: Har bir xodim o'z mas'uliyatini his qildi.
items.en: Every employee felt his/her responsibility.

items.uz: Bu tajribadan kelgusi rejalar uchun foydalanildi.
items.en: This experience was used for future plans.

items.uz: Muvaffaqiyatli yechim jamoaviy sa'y-harakat natijasi edi.
items.en: The successful solution was the result of collective effort.

items.uz: Sun'iy intellektning axloqiy jihatlari muhokama qilinmoqda.
items.en: The ethical aspects of artificial intelligence are being discussed.

items.uz: Shaxsiy ma'lumotlarni himoya qilish muhim masala.
items.en: Protecting personal data is an important issue.

items.uz: Texnologiya insoniyatga xizmat qilishi kerak, aksincha emas.
items.en: Technology should serve humanity, not the other way around.

items.uz: Bu tizim shaffoflik tamoyiliga asoslangan bo'lishi kerak.
items.en: This system must be based on the principle of transparency.

items.uz: Algoritmlarning xolisligi tekshirilishi zarur.
items.en: The impartiality of algorithms needs to be checked.

items.uz: Innovatsiya mas'uliyat bilan birga borishi lozim.
items.en: Innovation must go hand in hand with responsibility.

items.uz: Bu masala bo'yicha qonunchilik hali yetarli emas.
items.en: Legislation on this issue is not yet sufficient.

items.uz: Texnologik kompaniyalar o'z ta'sirini anglashi kerak.
items.en: Tech companies need to recognize their influence.

items.uz: Axloqiy qoidalar texnologiya bilan barobar rivojlanishi kerak.
items.en: Ethical rules need to develop alongside technology.

items.uz: Bu bahs jamiyat kelajagi uchun muhim ahamiyat kasb etadi.
items.en: This debate is of great importance for the future of society.
